Name: Not Ai Generated
Author: macro191
Description:
[center][b]The "Totally Human" Modder Experience[/b][/center][center][size=4][i]A 2026 Social Anxiety Simulator
[/i][/size][/center]
[quote][b]"I definitely wrote that script from scratch. Why are you looking at my browser history, Lewis?"
[/b][/quote]
[b]
It’s 2026. The world of modding has changed.[/b] 
You’ve just "authored" a groundbreaking new mod for Pelican Town. By "authored," we mean you spent six hours prompting an AI and thirty seconds hitting [color=#00ff00][b]Ctrl+V[/b][/color]. Now, the guilt—and the NPCs—are closing in.
This mod adds a layer of digital imposter syndrome to your farm life. While you’re trying to harvest parsnips, the citizens of Pelican Town have questions about your "coding journey," and your internal monologue is losing its mind.



[size=5][b]🛠 Features of "Authenticity"[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]Interrogative NPCs:[/b] Random encounters where villagers ask how the modding is going. Better have your excuses ready!
[*] [b]The Sweat Meter:[/b] Experience the hilarious, high-stakes panic of defending your "manual" labor through custom dialogue and thought bubbles.
[*] [b]Tactical Lying:[/b] Choose from multiple response paths. Will you play the "Humble Genius" or the "Overworked Martyr"?
[*] [b]Project Randomization:[/b] Every save file generates a unique, vaguely technical-sounding project name to lie about.
[*] [b]Deep Configuration:[/b] Use the [i]config.json[/i] to decide exactly how much social pressure you can handle.
[/list]


[size=5][b]💻 Tech Specs (For Humans, By Humans)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]Requirements:[/b] SMAPI 1.6+ and a functioning conscience.
[*] [b]Installation:[/b] Drag, drop, and pretend you built the folder structure yourself.
[*] [b]Compatibility:[/b] Works with everything. AI doesn't discriminate.
[/list]
[center][size=2][b]Credits[/b]
Written by an AI.
Irony Levels: Critical.
Human Involvement: Minimal to non-existent.[/size][/center]
